authorization.text: On 2026-10-12 the owner directed: "take this as starting point and deliver till end. Delivery this work with the AIWorks environment." The starting point is docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md (PR #12), with owner decisions D1, D3, D5 (direction only) and D9 recorded in its section 8. This campaign repairs the independently verified STA2 commit 84920b2db706 (PR #56), whose new test fails GitHub CI on Linux (#42), and supersedes that PR. Commits are published as PRs only: the supervisor never merges or deploys, and the live runtime, its data directory, the governance checkout and the scheduled tasks are never touched. No run cap or cost ceiling (AW-002); provider limits are waited out. Provider order Claude, then Codex.

constraints: Program netbka/aiworks#14: deliver docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md through supervisor campaigns. Change only the files your task names. Other campaigns change other files at the same time: never edit their files, other agents' branches or worktrees, or campaigns/*.json.

Your assigned worktree is the only place you change files. Never touch D:/Git/aiworks/.local (live runtime, supervisor data directory, governance checkout, other worktrees) or the main checkout, and never start, stop or restart the supervisor, its scheduled tasks or the dashboard.

No production access, deployment, GitHub Actions changes, paid services, Telegram or other provider API calls, or new recurring spend. Never read .env contents, credentials or secret files. Read Engineering Platform only with read-only gh commands; never write the governance checkout or open changes in another repository: EP-side changes are proposed as text.
Follow AGENTS.md: run npm ci once in your worktree, then npm run check after changes. Report exact commands and pass/fail tallies.

Never weaken an assertion, delete or skip a test, or broaden a timeout to make the gate pass. Tests make no model, network or GitHub calls: synthetic executables and disposable git repositories, as tests/supervisor/helpers.mjs does.

Keep AW-001 to AW-007 as written. Do not enable a power whose decision is still open (GitHub-free local admission, Auto Release, Telegram delivery): design it, or build it switched off, and name the decision it waits for.

Label every claim about the running system observed, verified, planned or unknown (AGENTS.md evidence rule); merged is not deployed. Do not comment on GitHub, merge, close issues or change labels: the supervisor publishes your verified commit. Write "Refs #N", never "Closes".
Write for the owner first: plain English, short sentences, the outcome before the mechanism. Link Engineering Platform policies instead of copying them.

Read GitHub with REST only (gh api repos/netbka/aiworks/issues/<n> --jq .body, .../comments, gh api repos/netbka/aiworks/pulls/<n>), never gh issue view or gh pr view: the account GraphQL quota is shared (#16, #21).

Repository CI runs npm ci and npm run check on ubuntu-latest (.github/workflows/check.yml). Every test you add or change must pass there and on Windows: guard platform-specific behaviour with a skip that names the reason, without weakening what it checks on Windows (#42). Copy the node:test summary lines (# tests, # pass, # fail, # skipped) verbatim from the output; never retype a tally (#43).

tasks.title: Make verified STA2 pass Linux CI (supersedes PR #56)
tasks.outcome: The STA2 work keeps every Windows check and passes the Linux CI run.
tasks.goal: PR #56 (branch campaign/aw-core-1/STA2) carries STA2, independently verified at 84920b2db706120086fd391901599cf2730da7f3, but GitHub CI on ubuntu-latest fails. The failure: 'not ok 299 - names that differ only in case are refused: expected CASE_COLLISION, got null'. The injected-listing test lists Readme.md and README.md while only Readme.md exists on disk; on Windows the stat of README.md succeeds because NTFS folds case, on Linux it fails, so the entry never reaches the collision check. In your worktree (current main): git fetch origin campaign/aw-core-1/STA2, then git merge --no-ff 84920b2db706120086fd391901599cf2730da7f3. Then fix the cause so the test is correct on Linux and Windows without weakening what it checks on Windows: prefer making the behaviour itself platform-independent where the design asks for that, otherwise make the test's setup platform-independent; a skip is acceptable only where a platform truly cannot express the case, and must name it. Run npm run check; in the PR say it supersedes #56, explain the root cause and why the fix keeps the Windows check, and copy the node:test summary lines verbatim.
constraints: Keep 84920b2db706120086fd391901599cf2730da7f3 as an ancestor of your commit. Beyond the merge change only: src/supervisor/project-preflight.mjs, tests/supervisor/project-preflight.test.mjs.
acceptance: HEAD contains 84920b2db706120086fd391901599cf2730da7f3 as an ancestor and its merge with main has no unresolved conflict.

The failing test passes on Linux CI and on Windows, or is skipped only where the platform cannot express the case, with the reason named; no Windows assertion is removed or weakened (the PR shows the diff).
npm run check passes on Windows; the summary lines are copied verbatim.
